label: rare: late original-phase steps in j/u-initial sequences containing 3s (after x/r)
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (56 activations in 1M sequences, weak magnitudes 0.10-0.16). Activations fall mostly on late original-phase steps (orig_idx 4-8, 1-3 tokens before <DEL>) in sequences whose first token is j or u and that contain one or more 3s early on (often 3 3), frequently right after x or r (prev2 often 3 or o). A few fire in the copy phase at recall_idx 1 or 3. Never fires at t<4 or on the delimiter step. The best conjunctive predicate reaches about 50% recall but only ~3% precision (dev F1 0.05): most steps matching the context do not activate it. Did not find a magnitude modulator.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 25 cues. Raise it: orig0=j (+2.61), prev_tok=x (+2.25), orig3=3 (+2.00), orig2=3 (+1.93), orig0=u (+1.84), orig1=j (+1.74). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.25), orig7=- (-1.48), next_out=- (-1.46), prev3_tok=- (-1.21).
